integrity: Mathematical proof accompanies the recurrence; finite exact checks corroborate but do not replace the proof. The Green transfer block and general electrical-routing framework were previously available and are not claimed as original. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted real finite two-rail ladders only; no result for anisotropic weights, cylindrical ladders, or wider strips. Exact rational finite checks do not constitute the all-size proof. Equivalent statements in older specialist circuit literature remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Central-rung dominance and exact edge-projection constants on finite ladders
